# AthereOS v3.0
*<p align="center">Now in Dendritic Form!</p>*

My NixOS Dotfiles. Built with [Den Framework](https://den.denful.dev/).

## This is a mirror
Main repository is hosted at [Codeberg](https://codeberg.org/AthereoAndromeda/athereos-v3)
